OnMyWay is the original Employee Safety-as-a-Service protection and rewards platform that helps people stay safe while earning real rewards.

260+ lives saved. 40,154+ incidents prevented.

The OnMyWay Protection Platform combines AI safety technology, Real People and Rewards

OnMyWay rewards safe behavior with OnMyWay Dollars that unlock cash prizes, gift cards, travel, brand rewards, instant‑win games, and high‑value grand prizes — backed by over $100 million in rotating rewards designed to change behavior and save lives.

OnMyWay Rewards & Prizes

Cash & Cash‑Equivalent Prizes
Cash prizes
Instant‑win cash rewards
Sweepstakes with large cash payouts
Cash bundled with physical prizes 

Gamified Rewards & Instant Wins

OnMyWay emphasizes gamification, including:

Instant‑win games
Vault‑style prize mechanics
Challenges and contests
Limited‑time reward events

Gamification increases engagement and repeats safe behavior.

Enterprise & Workforce Incentives

For organizations, rewards are used to:

Increase employee adoption of safety tools
Reinforce company safety policies
Reduce crashes and claims
Demonstrate proactive risk reduction


We celebrate 90%+ adoption rates when rewards are paired with safety programs.

OnMyWay Protection Platform — an AI-powered safety, compliance, and rewards platform built for businesses while continuing to reward individuals for living Safely.

For Individuals in Community (Free Version)

Earn rewards.
• Earn OnMyWay “Dollars” for being safe 
• Redeem your Dollars for travel, premium prizes, and giveaways
• Turn safe living into real rewards

For Companies (Premium / Paid Version)

An enterprise protection platform that strengthens:
• Employee safety
• Compliance visibility
• Emergency response readiness
• Operational risk mitigation
• Distraction prevention
• Measurable safety incentives

Powered by advanced AI + live human emergency support, the platform protects employees on the road, at work, traveling, and on the go while documenting safety engagement and compliance automatically.

Complete protection from physical threats, digital threats, and compliance failures — powered by advanced AI + real people.

2) Archie® AI Voice Assistant — Do anything, hands‑free.
3) Crash Detection & Emergency Dispatch — Seconds matter.
